The '''Ossiathora system''' was located in the [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]], a part of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It contained the [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] [[Ossiathora]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ossiathora [[Star system/Legends|system]] was mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-17.<ref name="TEA" />
